summary:
Independent design Review of the complete frozen amended Task56 specification 3a782321645c40b71cf4921a7322872bf45285bf009218edb3e1d4d9310c53ce and current design context c6f79f9bf7a40f3c5c675f4206e34fd801a53d2334f7fb6aebe8b87b875f8508, including design amendment 004, the byte-preserved old e3fc specification, run004 failure and actual isolated benchmark. No blocking design finding. This real reviewer has not authored the production source, integration utility or tests, and performs the independent design Review and verification as the same actual worker.

The additional scope is exactly repository_fixture.py, integration conftest.py, test_repository_fixture.py and the thin create_repository connection. The canonical utility must provide one pytest session/worker owner across both existing helper import names, with a short private tmp_path_factory directory under the actual current EXEC leaf and independent owners across sessions/workers/runs. Non-pytest calls remain cold. The first original target must retain path.mkdir followed by the original real init/current copies/writes/add/commit sequence and its original failure/partial behavior. Only a fully successful, pristine, not-started repository can publish its snapshot before returning. Optional qualification/publication failure must preserve the original successful return and disable reuse; a failed original builder publishes nothing. Warm copy failure must propagate with its partial destination and no builder retry, deletion or cleanup.

Every warm eligibility decision still reads complete current schemas/Policy/templates names/types/modes/bytes, current source/constants, standard helper identities, Git/runtime/volume/session bindings, configuration origin files plus possible new config/attributes paths, and the proved default template inputs/absence facts. Neither restored mtime, a fixed HEAD nor an old digest substitutes for these live reads. Unknown/path-sensitive/include config, active hooks/filter/attributes, signing, special Git layouts/formats, GIT overrides, unsafe inputs, monkeypatch or uncertain platform/template coverage remain cold without changing the inherited environment or settings. Configuration qualification material is handled only in memory; unknown names, values, origins and exception content must not be echoed or persisted.

The observed thirteen standard system names permit an exact conditional allowlist, not prefix expansion: ordinary supported core symlink/autocrlf/fscache options, the specific color/help/rebase options unused by this initial operation, the exact astextplain textconv key, credential.helper and four exact LFS keys. Credentials are not acquired or inspected by the local initial builder with no remote or active hook/filter. The LFS keys are eligible only when the complete ordinary initial files and all applicable worktree, info, system/global and default-template attributes inputs are proved absent/inactive; uncertainty goes cold. Inactive credential/LFS values need not be forced to a particular executable string to assert that they are never invoked, but every current configuration-byte/absence change must invalidate reuse. No unknown key becomes eligible merely to obtain a cache hit. PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST may be excluded only from the cache key as the explicit internal per-case label; actual child environment stays original and related/unknown Git/environment drift still causes cold fallback. Real warm use and complete qualification cost are implementation acceptance obligations, not facts established by this design Review.

Snapshot and every copy must have independently copied ordinary worktree and complete Git index/objects/refs/logs/config files, without hardlinks, alternates, linked worktrees or reparse sharing. Later start, classification, freezing, current Git checks, schema and Policy validation, identities, freshness, approvals and verification all execute normally per case. No task/events/Review/context or production conclusion is cached. Necessary acceptance covers both helper imports and owner isolation; original mkdir/init/add/commit/source-copy and publication/warm-copy errors; independent two-way worktree/index/object/ref changes; live source/config/template addition, deletion and same-size/restored-mtime drift; attributes/hooks/unknown-key and synthetic-secret privacy rejection; helper/environment changes; and the unchanged real owned-child ten-second timeout case.

The preserved original e3fc specification hash and benchmark hashes match their actual bytes. The benchmark completed actual pytest exit zero without outer timeout on an unchanged source; twenty original builders averaged 0.36050646 seconds and physical copy plus current 34-file fingerprints averaged 0.05784147 seconds. Those measurements exclude complete eligibility and integrity assertion work and do not prove the original timeout cause, broad platform compatibility or a future native pass. Complete run004 remains FAILED, 13/14, with the original integration 600-second timeout and consumed action004. Complete guarded eligibility/warm-use measurement and the unchanged integration selection must precede a fresh exact-action full native V2.

The cumulative design retains the original external-temp ownership and path refusal boundaries, fixture physical-I/O and bounded Git cleanup constraints, and pure YAML decoding isolation with fresh actual file reads and all live validations. Original assertions, selectors, MINENV, Policy, schemas/workflows, thresholds, budgets and fixed mutations remain unchanged. Implementation Review, native finalization, current code approval, Gate and complete required CI remain necessary; no performance success, implementation approval, task completion, publication or reuse of a consumed action is asserted by this design approval.
